In practice follow the correction tables in the type performance manual.
map.为什么高温高海拔跑道要更长？: Why do high-temperature high-elevation runways need to be longer?
map.海拔高、温度高→空气密度低→同等表速下动压小、升力与发动机推力都下降，需要更长滑: High elevation and high temperature mean lower air density, so at the same indicated airspeed the dynamic pressure is lower and both lift and engine thrust drop, requiring a longer roll to reach lift-off speed, hence a longer runway or a reduced takeoff weight.
map.坡度、顶风怎么影响？: How do slope and headwind affect it?
map.上坡增加所需长度、下坡减少；顶风缩短、顺风加长。完整性能计算把这些修正一并叠加，: An upslope increases and a downslope decreases the required length; a headwind shortens and a tailwind lengthens it. A full performance calculation superimposes all these corrections; this tool illustrates with the given elevation/temperature terms.
